articles.title: Bitcoin risks slump after hitting ‘major bear market resistance’: CryptoQuant
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s rally may reverse as its price has hit a historic resistance level and traders appear to already be taking profits, said CryptoQuant in a note on Wednesday.

articles.title: Tezos Tests Post-Quantum Privacy as Founder Slams 'Half-Baked' Bitcoin Quantum Theories
articles.snippet: Arthur Breitman's comments come as Tezos tests a post-quantum privacy system designed to protect encrypted blockchain data from future attacks.

articles.title: Bitcoin Rally Cut Short as Profit-Taking Rises, US Demand Falls: CryptoQuant
articles.snippet: Bitcoin's recent rally stalled at a critical level, putting the top crypto asset in a position that has previously led to major downturns.

articles.title: Quantum Computing Threat 'Mostly a Coordination Issue' for Bitcoin: Fireblocks CEO
articles.snippet: Michael Shaulov argued that changing to a post-quantum cryptographic signature scheme is “not a technical challenge” for Bitcoin.
